From 0373d5c387f24de749cc22e694a14b3a7c7eb515 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 16:30:24 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] bnxt_en: Fix XDP_TX path

For XDP_TX action in bnxt_rx_xdp(), clearing of the event flags is not
correct.  __bnxt_poll_work() -> bnxt_rx_pkt() -> bnxt_rx_xdp() may be
looping within NAPI and some event flags may be set in earlier
iterations.  In particular, if BNXT_TX_EVENT is set earlier indicating
some XDP_TX packets are ready and pending, it will be cleared if it is
XDP_TX action again.  Normally, we will set BNXT_TX_EVENT again when we
successfully call __bnxt_xmit_xdp().  But if the TX ring has no more
room, the flag will not be set.  This will cause the TX producer to be
ahead but the driver will not hit the TX doorbell.

For multi-buf XDP_TX, there is no need to clear the event flags and set
BNXT_AGG_EVENT.  The BNXT_AGG_EVENT flag should have been set earlier in
bnxt_rx_pkt().

The visible symptom of this is that the RX ring associated with the
TX XDP ring will eventually become empty and all packets will be dropped.
Because this condition will cause the driver to not refill the RX ring
seeing that the TX ring has forever pending XDP_TX packets.

The fix is to only clear BNXT_RX_EVENT when we have successfully
called __bnxt_xmit_xdp().

Fixes: 7f0a168b0441 ("bnxt_en: Add completion ring pointer in TX and RX ring structures")
Reported-by: Pavel Dubovitsky <pdubovitsky@meta.com>
Reviewed-by: Andy Gospodarek <andrew.gospodarek@broadcom.com>
Reviewed-by: Pavan Chebbi <pavan.chebbi@broadcom.com>
Reviewed-by: Kalesh AP <kalesh-anakkur.purayil@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Reviewed-by: Jacob Keller <jacob.e.keller@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251203003024.2246699-1-michael.chan@broadcom.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_xdp.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_xdp.c
index 3e77a96e5a3e..c94a391b1ba5 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_xdp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_xdp.c
@@ -268,13 +268,11 @@ bool bnxt_rx_xdp(struct bnxt *bp, struct bnxt_rx_ring_info *rxr, u16 cons,
 	case XDP_TX:
 		rx_buf = &rxr->rx_buf_ring[cons];
 		mapping = rx_buf->mapping - bp->rx_dma_offset;
-		*event &= BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT;
 
 		if (unlikely(xdp_buff_has_frags(xdp))) {
 			struct skb_shared_info *sinfo = xdp_get_shared_info_from_buff(xdp);
 
 			tx_needed += sinfo->nr_frags;
-			*event = BNXT_AGG_EVENT;
 		}
 
 		if (tx_avail < tx_needed) {
@@ -287,6 +285,7 @@ bool bnxt_rx_xdp(struct bnxt *bp, struct bnxt_rx_ring_info *rxr, u16 cons,
 		dma_sync_single_for_device(&pdev->dev, mapping + offset, *len,
 					   bp->rx_dir);
 
+		*event &= ~BNXT_RX_EVENT;
 		*event |= BNXT_TX_EVENT;
 		__bnxt_xmit_xdp(bp, txr, mapping + offset, *len,
 				NEXT_RX(rxr->rx_prod), xdp);
-- 
2.34.1

This patch fixes a bug in the `bnxt_en` driver's XDP_TX path where incorrect event flag management could cause missing TX doorbell and eventual RX ring starvation. The only file modified is `drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_xdp.c`.

**Modifications in `bnxt_xdp.c`:**

1. **Removed**: `*event &= BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT;` at the beginning of the `XDP_TX` case. This line cleared all event flags except `BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT`, which could inadvertently clear `BNXT_TX_EVENT` (set in earlier NAPI iterations) and lead to missing the TX doorbell when TX ring was full later.

2. **Removed**: `*event = BNXT_AGG_EVENT;` inside the multi-buf XDP_TX branch. The `BNXT_AGG_EVENT` flag is already set correctly earlier in `bnxt_rx_pkt()`, so overriding it was unnecessary and incorrect.

3. **Added**: `*event &= ~BNXT_RX_EVENT;` after the `dma_sync_single_for_device()` call and before setting `BNXT_TX_EVENT`. This ensures that the `BNXT_RX_EVENT` flag is cleared only when XDP_TX transmission succeeds, while preserving other event flags (especially `BNXT_TX_EVENT` if previously set) that are needed for proper NAPI processing.

**Relationships between the modifications:**  
The three changes work together to preserve the correct state of event flags across multiple XDP_TX calls within the same NAPI poll loop. Previously, clearing all flags at the start could lose `BNXT_TX_EVENT`, causing the TX doorbell to never be rung. The fix only clears `BNXT_RX_EVENT` and sets `BNXT_TX_EVENT` at the point of successful transmission, leaving other flags (including any `BNXT_TX_EVENT` set from earlier iterations) intact. The removal of the multi-buf override avoids overwriting the already-set `BNXT_AGG_EVENT` flag. This ensures proper synchronization between TX and RX rings, preventing RX ring starvation.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
<text>
*event &= BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT;
</text>
<text>
*event = BNXT_AGG_EVENT;
</text>
Reason:
The first statement clears all event flags except BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT at the start of the XDP_TX case. This can erase a BNXT_TX_EVENT that was set in a previous NAPI iteration, preventing the TX doorbell from being rung when the TX ring later has no room. The second statement overrides the event flags entirely with BNXT_AGG_EVENT for multi-buf XDP, discarding any previously set BNXT_TX_EVENT. Both actions lead to missing TX doorbell and eventual RX ring starvation.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>
*event &= ~BNXT_RX_EVENT;
</text>
<text>
*event |= BNXT_TX_EVENT;
</text>
Reason:
These lines are moved to after the TX availability check and before calling __bnxt_xmit_xdp(). They only clear BNXT_RX_EVENT and set BNXT_TX_EVENT when a packet is actually transmitted. This preserves any prior event flags (such as BNXT_TX_EVENT set in earlier iterations) and ensures the TX doorbell is correctly rung when needed, preventing RX ring starvation.
